query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Manage Meta ads reporting and campaign status, and handle Facebook Page inbox workflows including reading conversations and sending private replies or bulk follow-up messages.
query_ground_truth.intent: This query fetches incoming messages and conversation threads from a Facebook Page inbox.

requirement_groups.purpose: fetch conversation threads from page inbox

results.execution_guidance: IMPORTANT: Follow the recommended plan below. Extract steps before execution, adapt to your current context, execute sequentially with current_step parameter, and check known pitfalls to avoid errors.
recommended_plan_steps: [Required] [Prerequisite (if page_id unknown)]: Identify the managed Page using FACEBOOK_LIST_MANAGED_PAGES (optionally confirm the selection using FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_DETAILS).

[Required] [Step]: Enumerate inbox threads using FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS (capture conversation_id plus summary fields; paginate via paging.cursors.after/paging.next; dedupe IDs and stop if the cursor does not advance).

[Fallback (if FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS returns 403 OAuthException code 298 or empty unexpectedly)] [Fallback]: Re-check the chosen page_id and required inbox-read permissions, then retry FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS.

[Required (for a chosen thread)] [Step]: Read message history using FACEBOOK_GET_CONVERSATION_MESSAGES (keep both page_id and conversation_id; start with a small limit; parse items from response.data.data; paginate via paging cursors/next for older messages).
[Optional (if per-message fields are needed)] [Next Step]: Inspect a specific message using FACEBOOK_GET_MESSAGE_DETAILS (use message_id from the message list).

[Optional (only with explicit approval; state-changing)] [Next Step]: Update thread state or respond using FACEBOOK_MARK_MESSAGE_SEEN and/or FACEBOOK_SEND_MESSAGE (verify the target conversation and recipient details before writing).
known_pitfalls: [FACEBOOK_LIST_MANAGED_PAGES] Responses may include access_token-like fields; treat as secrets and avoid logging or persisting.
[FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS] Per-call results are capped (commonly 25); requesting above the cap can trigger an invalid-request error.
[FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS] 403 OAuthException code 298 indicates missing permissions to read the Page inbox.
[FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS] Paging cursors can repeat the same conversation IDs; dedupe and break if the cursor does not advance to avoid loops.
[FACEBOOK_GET_CONVERSATION_MESSAGES] Message rows are nested at response.data.data and can include system-style items with empty message text; a valid thread may also return an empty list.

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Facebook is a social media and advertising platform used by individuals and businesses to connect, share content, and promote products or services. Only supports Facebook Pages, not Facebook Personal accounts.
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=facebook. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="facebook") to create a connection BEFORE executing any facebook tools.

FACEBOOK_GET_PAGE_CONVERSATIONS.description: Retrieves a list of conversations between users and the Page.

limit.description: Number of conversations to return (max 25) Use `paging.cursors.after` or `paging.next` from the response to paginate beyond the first page.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return for each conversation Avoid requesting heavy nested fields (e.g., embedded messages) to prevent large payloads.

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page. Numeric IDs are accepted and will be converted to strings.

FACEBOOK_GET_CONVERSATION_MESSAGES.description: Retrieves messages from a specific conversation.

limit.description: Number of messages to return (max 25) To retrieve full histories, paginate using `paging.cursors.after` or the `next` URL from the response.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return for each message. Available fields include: id, created_time, from, to, message, attachments, sticker, shares, tags.

page_id.description: The ID of the Facebook Page that owns the conversation. Required to obtain the correct page access token. Get this from the List Managed Pages action.

conversation_id.description: The ID of the conversation in the format 't_' followed by a numeric ID (e.g., 't_3638640842939952'). Obtain valid conversation IDs from the Get Page Conversations action. If a numeric-only ID is provided, the 't_' prefix will be added automatically.

FACEBOOK_LIST_MANAGED_PAGES.description: Retrieves a list of Facebook Pages that the user manages (not personal profiles), including page details, access tokens, and tasks. Requires `pages_show_list` or `pages_read_engagement` OAuth scopes; missing scopes silently return empty results rather than an error. An empty `data` array means the user manages no Pages. Results are paginated via `paging.cursors`; follow `paging.next` until absent to retrieve all Pages when count exceeds `limit`. Graph API throttling (error codes 4, 17, 613) can occur during pagination — use exponential backoff.

after.description: Cursor string for forward pagination. Use the 'after' cursor from a previous response's paging.cursors.after field to retrieve the next page of results.

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to retrieve per request.

before.description: Cursor string for backward pagination. Use the 'before' cursor from a previous response's paging.cursors.before field to retrieve the previous page of results.

fields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to return for each managed page.

user_id.description: The ID of the user whose managed pages to retrieve. Defaults to 'me' for current user.
